description: NaY(BH₄)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic C222₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.62 Å. Y is bonded to twelve H atoms to form distorted YH₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with four BH₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-H bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.39 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four H atoms to form BH₄ tetrahedra that share  a faceface with one YH₁₂ cuboctahedra. There is one shorter (1.20 Å) and three longer (1.24 Å) B-H bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded to four H atoms to form BH₄ tetrahedra that share  a faceface with one YH₁₂ cuboctahedra. There is one shorter (1.21 Å) and three longer (1.24 Å) B-H bond lengths. There are eight inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one B atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one B atom. In the third H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one B atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na, one Y, and one B atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one B atom. In the seventh H site, H is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one B atom. In the eighth H site, H is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Y and one B atom.
